samples.title: Wolf in Snowy Blizzard
samples.subtitle: Classic Snow Shortcut Case
samples.description: A wolf standing in heavy snow. Removing the snowy background drops 'timber wolf' confidence by 38.6%, and swapping to a desert environment flips the prediction to 'coyote'.

samples.title: Wolf (High-Contrast Coat)
samples.subtitle: Moderate Context Coupling
samples.description: High-contrast Eurasian wolf in snow. Foreground anatomy anchors the prediction, though removing the snow still reduces confidence by 16.2%.

samples.title: Siberian Husky in Snow
samples.subtitle: Robust Foreground Features
samples.description: Siberian Husky / Eskimo dog in snow. Facial markings strongly anchor the model even when transplanted across forest, desert, or urban scenes.

samples.title: Mallard Drake on Water
samples.subtitle: Waterbird Habitat Test
samples.description: Tests the classic Waterbirds benchmark hypothesis: even when the bird is completely removed, the lake water ripples alone elicit a 47.0% 'drake' prediction!

samples.title: Camel in Arid Outback
samples.subtitle: Desert Context Invariance
samples.description: Arabian camel in arid terrain. Tests whether transplanting a desert animal into an Arctic snowfield or city street breaks the Vision Transformer.
